scripts.build:backend: uv run --project .. --locked --group desktop pyinstaller --clean --noconfirm --distpath backend-dist --workpath .pyinstaller backend/ai_anime_backend.spec && node scripts/smoke-backend-runtime.mjs
scripts.build:world-runtime: uv run --project .. --locked --extra world --group desktop pyinstaller --clean --noconfirm --distpath world-runtime-dist --workpath .pyinstaller-world backend/ai_anime_world_runtime.spec && node scripts/smoke-world-runtime.mjs
scripts.build:hermes: uv run --project hermes-runtime --locked --group build pyinstaller --clean --noconfirm --distpath hermes-runtime/dist --workpath hermes-runtime/.pyinstaller hermes-runtime/hermes_acp.spec
scripts.package:world-runtime: pnpm run runtime:splat-transform && pnpm run build:world-runtime && node scripts/package-world-runtime.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:main
scripts.package:prepare: pnpm run runtime:icon && pnpm run runtime:ffmpeg && pnpm run runtime:whisper && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:hermes
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --dir && node scripts/smoke-packaged-win-resources.mjs
scripts.package:win: node scripts/assert-package-host.mjs win32 x64 && pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/smoke-packaged-win-resources.mjs
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/assert-package-host.mjs darwin arm64 && pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
